WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.sale_date, f.quantity, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.etl_loaded_at,
         p.sku, p.subcategory AS sub_was, cp.subcategory AS sub_is, p.category AS cat_was
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
)
SELECT 'n_lines' k, count(*) v, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) v2 FROM lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'units_all_cats', sum(quantity), 0 FROM lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'units_interior_is', sum(quantity), count(*) FROM lines WHERE sub_is='Interior Paint'
UNION ALL SELECT 'units_interior_was', sum(quantity), count(*) FROM lines WHERE sub_was='Interior Paint'
UNION ALL SELECT 'units_interior_is_staff', sum(quantity), count(*) FROM lines WHERE sub_is='Interior Paint' AND staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL SELECT 'units_interior_is_dup_etl', count(*) - count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) FROM lines WHERE sub_is='Interior Paint'
UNION ALL SELECT 'qty_neg_or_zero', count(*), 0 FROM lines WHERE quantity<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'mindate', CAST(min(sale_date) AS BIGINT) , CAST(max(sale_date) AS BIGINT) FROM lines

  SELECT f.sale_date, sum(f.quantity) AS units, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_keys,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', min(f.sale_ts_utc) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS minhel
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
  GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT business_date, units_sold FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02')

UNION ALL

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS fiscal_period, cp.subcategory,
       SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_returned),0) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product rp ON rp.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_product rcp ON rcp.sku=rp.sku AND rcp.is_current JOIN dim_date rd ON rd.calendar_date=r.return_date
         WHERE rs.store_id=108 AND rcp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND rd.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND rd.fiscal_period=3) AS units_returned_in_period
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY ALL
